scripts.contracts:test: bash -lc 'if command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1; then forge test --root contracts; else echo "forge not installed; skipping contract tests"; fi'
scripts.contracts:deploy:arc: bash -lc 'if command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1; then forge script contracts/script/DeployOathReceipt.s.sol --rpc-url "$ARC_TESTNET_RPC_URL" --private-key "$ARC_TESTNET_PRIVATE_KEY" --broadcast --root contracts; else echo "forge not installed" && exit 1; fi'
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm contracts:test
